why: Intro to Docker plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-docker.json), 'Serve a page and map a port' (passes: a container named web is running and localhost port 8080 answers). The first run worked and `docker ps` showed web Up on 0.0.0.0:8080->80/tcp. The learner then stopped it and ran the step's command again: 'Conflict. The container name "/web" is already in use', so nothing started. The last `docker ps` lists no containers. The port line and 'Up' are stale scrollback.

step.title: Serve nginx on port 8080
step.instructions: Run docker run -d --name web -p 8080:80 nginx. Then docker ps should show web running with 0.0.0.0:8080->80/tcp; open http://localhost:8080 to see the nginx page.
